name: 陳凱瀛
objective:
當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，智慧生產工程師需考量如何整合智慧製造與精實生產。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解智慧製造在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂數位導向的企業。
Since business are moving toward information and automation, smart production engineers need to consider how to integrate smart manufacturing and lean production. The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called digitalized enterprise.
schedule:
week 1-week 3 數位優化與轉型
week 4-week 5 智慧製造與數位科技 (AI) 應用
week 6 期中測驗
week 7-week 12 案例簡介 
week 13-week 14 製造執行系統介紹與實作 
week 15-week 16 案例簡介
week17-week 18 期末分組報告
scorePolicy:
上課與出席 40%
期中測驗 20%
期末報告 40%
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
